release_notes: MBT POS v3.1.6 lets the till save an M-Pesa sale from the customer code and phone without waiting on the payments cloud. Split pay is only the Mixed method, so a cash sale is no longer blocked by a leftover electronic amount. Stock deliveries keep each buying price, and profit uses the cost of the units actually sold. Cashiers see today's sales and receipts, can copy a receipt number, and can ask an admin to void; the admin approves that void on this PC or the web dashboard with the Super-Admin PIN. Also carries the v3.1.5 single-window launch behaviour. Preserves AppData identity, license state and mbt_pos.db.
